text_en: My child, if you have given your pledge to your neighbor, if you have bound yourself to another,
text_cn: 我儿，你如果为你的朋友作保，或为外人击掌；

text_en: you are snared by the utterance of your lips, caught by the words of your mouth.
text_cn: 你如果为你口中说的话所连累，为你口中的言词所束缚，

text_en: So do this, my child, and save yourself, for you have come into your neighbor’s power: go, hurry, and plead with your neighbor.
text_cn: 那么，我儿，你既然已陷在你友人的手中，你就该逃脱，该这样做：火速前去，央求你的友人，

text_en: Give your eyes no sleep and your eyelids no slumber;
text_cn: 不要合上眼睛睡觉，也不要垂下眼睑假寐，

text_en: save yourself like a gazelle from the hunter, like a bird from the hand of the fowler.
text_cn: 应急速解救自己，如羚羊挣脱罗网，飞鸟逃脱猎人的圈套。

text_en: Go to the ant, you lazybones; consider its ways, and be wise.
text_cn: 懒汉，你去看看蚂蚁，观察它的作风，便可得些智识：

text_en: Without having any chief or officer or ruler,
text_cn: 它没有领袖，没有监督，没有君王；

text_en: it prepares its food in summer, and gathers its sustenance in harvest.
text_cn: 但在夏天却知准备食粮，在秋收时积贮养料。

text_en: How long will you lie there, O lazybones? When will you rise from your sleep?
text_cn: 懒汉，你要睡到几时，你几时才睡醒？

text_en: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest,
text_cn: “再睡片刻，再假寐片刻，再抱臂躺卧片刻！”

text_en: and poverty will come upon you like a robber, and want, like an armed warrior.
text_cn: 这样贫穷就要如同窃贼，困乏也要如同武士，向你侵袭。

text_en: A scoundrel and a villain goes around with crooked speech,
text_cn: 无赖与恶徒，行事满口欺诈；

text_en: winking the eyes, shuffling the feet, pointing the fingers,
text_cn: 他以眼传神，以脚示意，以手指东画西。

text_en: with perverted mind devising evil, continually sowing discord;
text_cn: 他存心不良，常蓄意惹事生非。

text_en: on such a one calamity will descend suddenly; in a moment, damage beyond repair.
text_cn: 为此，他的丧亡必突然来临，霎时间全被毁灭，无法挽救。

text_en: There are six things that the Lord hates, seven that are an abomination to him:
text_cn: 上主憎恨的事，共有六件，连他心里最厌恶的事，共有七件：

text_en: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
text_cn: 傲慢的眼睛，撒谎的舌头，流无辜者血的手，

text_en: a heart that devises wicked plans, feet that hurry to run to evil,
text_cn: 策划阴谋的心，疾趋行恶的脚，

text_en: a lying witness who testifies falsely, and one who sows discord in a family.
text_cn: 说谎的假见证，和在兄弟间搬弄是非的人。

text_en: My child, keep your father’s commandment, and do not forsake your mother’s teaching.
text_cn: 我儿，应坚守你父亲的命令，不要放弃你母亲的教训；

text_en: Bind them upon your heart always; tie them around your neck.
text_cn: 应将二者常刻在你心中，系在你的颈项上。

text_en: When you walk, they will lead you; when you lie down, they will watch over you; and when you awake, they will talk with you.
text_cn: 她们在你行路时引领你，在你躺卧时看护你；在你醒来时与你交谈。

text_en: For the commandment is a lamp and the teaching a light, and the reproofs of discipline are the way of life,
text_cn: 因为父命是盏灯，母教是光明，严格的劝告是生命的道路，

text_en: to preserve you from the wife of another, from the smooth tongue of the adulteress.
text_cn: 使你远避恶意的女人，离开淫妇阿谀的言词，

text_en: Do not desire her beauty in your heart, and do not let her capture you with her eyelashes;
text_cn: 不让你的心贪恋她的美色，不让她的秋波迷惑你，

text_en: for a prostitute’s fee is only a loaf of bread, but the wife of another stalks a man’s very life.
text_cn: 因为娼妓所求的只是一块饼，有夫之妇却猎取宝贵的生命。

text_en: Can fire be carried in the bosom without burning one’s clothes?
text_cn: 人岂能怀中藏火，而不烧毁自己的衣服？

text_en: Or can one walk on hot coals without scorching the feet?
text_cn: 人岂能在火炭上行走，而不灼伤自己的脚？

text_en: So is he who sleeps with his neighbor’s wife; no one who touches her will go unpunished.
text_cn: 与他人妻子通奸的人就是这样：凡接近她的，必难免受罚。

text_en: Thieves are not despised who steal only to satisfy their appetite when they are hungry.
text_cn: 盗贼若因饥饿行窃以果腹，人都不鄙视他；

text_en: Yet if they are caught, they will pay sevenfold; they will forfeit all the goods of their house.
text_cn: 但若被擒获了，他仍须七倍偿还，交出家中所有的财物。

text_en: But he who commits adultery has no sense; he who does it destroys himself.
text_cn: 与妇人通奸的人，实属愚眛，他这样做，却是毁灭自己。

text_en: He will get wounds and dishonor, and his disgrace will not be wiped away.
text_cn: 他必遭受可耻的打击，并且他的耻辱，永不得拭去；

text_en: For jealousy arouses a husband’s fury, and he shows no restraint when he takes revenge.
text_cn: 因为妒火能激怒男人，使他在报复时，决不留情；

text_en: He will accept no compensation, and refuses a bribe no matter how great.
text_cn: 任何的赔偿，他都不理睬；即便你多送礼品，他也不肯罢休。
